r = parse.parse('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20 b')
```

The input string is `'a 1997-07-16T19:20 b'`. The pattern should match just the datetime part `1997-07-16T19:20`.

Looking at the regex for `ti`:
```
s = r'(\d{4}-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2}))((\s+|T)%s)?(Z|\s*[-+]\d{1,4}(?::?\d{2})?)?' % TIME_PAT
```

This expands to:
```
(\d{4}-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2}))((\s+|T)(\d{1,2}:\d{1,2}(:\d{1,2}(\.\d+)?)?))?(Z|\s*[-+]\d{1,4}(?::?\d{2})?)?
```

```

```
